what: The card becomes a glass pane that blurs the background behind it by 15px and distorts it with noise refraction (one of four at random). While it travels from the 92% line of the screen to the 6% line (scrub .6), it floats up from 52px below·.94x·glass 0, settling in place at the .24 share with glass 1 (power2.out), and from the .06 share the text clears from blur 14px by .18 shares at .05 intervals. From the .62 share the text fades out to blur 18px (power1.in .03 intervals), and from the .64 share the card grows to 72px up·1.08x and the glass turns off (power2.in .36 share) as it exits — width 768px and up

options.rise: Distance from below on entry (px), default 52
options.lift: Distance above on exit (px, negative), default −72
options.min: Scrubs only at this width (px) or above, default 768 — phones get the glass panel only
options.--fx-glow: Inner light border color (via style), default --kf-accent-soft
options.[data-fx-part=text]: Text that fades in and out (optional, in sequence)

note: It only reads as glass when placed over an image (on a plain background the blur is invisible)

from.where: index.html What we can do cards (.home-about-content-item)
